Ooredoo الجزائر تجدّد مرافقتها للبرنامج: Ooredoo Algeria renews its support for the educational program of the "El Baraka" association
في إطار التزامها المتواصل بدعم التربية و: As part of its continuous commitment to supporting education and promoting inclusion, Ooredoo Algeria, on the occasion of the back-to-school season, renews its support for the educational support program supervised by the National Association for the Support of Persons with Disabilities "El Baraka" for the benefit of children, especially those with special needs.
عبر مساهمة مالية جديدة تغطي السنتين الدر: Through a new financial contribution covering the 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 academic years, Ooredoo Algeria continues to support this program which pays special attention to school children with disabilities, alongside children from needy families, with the aim of helping them continue their educational path in the best conditions.
وقد جرى تجديد هذا الدعم خلال حفل أقيم بم: This support was renewed during a ceremony held at the association's headquarters, in the presence of Ooredoo Algeria's Corporate Social Responsibility team, led by Mr. Ramdane Djazairi, Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations, and Corporate Social Responsibility, where Ooredoo reaffirmed through this initiative the continuity of a partnership spanning several years.
خلال الفترة الممتدة من 2021 إلى 2026، اس: During the period from 2021 to 2026, more than 220 children with disabilities benefited from this program across nine (09) wilayas of the country, where they were supported in their educational path and supported for their integration, development, and academic success.
تجدّد Ooredoo الجزائر من خلال هذه المباد: Through this initiative, which coincides with the back-to-school season, Ooredoo Algeria renews its commitment to establishing equal opportunities and school inclusion and accompanying children with disabilities, relying on sustainable partnerships with active associations in the field committed to serving the community.
وتعكس هذه المساهمة الجديدة إرادة المؤسسة: This new contribution reflects the company's desire to make every back-to-school season an occasion that carries hope, inclusion, and success for all children, especially school children with disabilities.
